subject: Request for interim pilot credits while PO processes
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novalegal.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: twu@novalegal.com, procurement@novalegal.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request — PO stuck in Coupa

Hi Mateo,

We kicked off the evaluation last week and the engineering team is blocked — procurement has our PO (PO #45678) in Coupa but it’s still routing for approvals. Legal says it could be another 2–3 weeks. Can Redwood provide a short interim extension or supplemental credits so the pilot doesn’t lapse while procurement finishes?

We’re excited about the latency and cost numbers you shared, but the team needs uninterrupted access to complete the final integration tests. If helpful, I can share a screenshot from our Coupa queue.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Sr. Technical Program Manager
NovaLegal

Attachment: NovaLegal_PO_pending_screenshot.png (image/png)
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novalegal.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — PO stuck in Coupa

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the note and the Coupa screenshot. Totally understand the need to keep your engineers moving. We can offer a short-term top-up to keep the pilot live while procurement finishes. Proposed interim support: 150k credits (equivalent to ~250k tokens for your current workload), valid for two weeks from activation.

Couple quick asks so we can provision immediately:
- Confirm the team email we should tie the supplement to (is it eng@novalegal.com or twu@novalegal.com?).
- If you can share a target PO approval date (even tentative), it helps us set the expiry window.

I’ve looped in Ben (sales lead) and Laura (legal) so we can approve and document the supplement. Once we have the contact, I’ll provision and send an acceptance note with a small temporary terms addendum.

Best,

Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Go ahead and provision the supplement. Approve 150k credits for NovaLegal tied to twu@novalegal.com (engineering contact). Conditions:

- Request a PO or written confirmation within 30 days of provisioning; if we don’t receive it, credits will be revoked.
- Attach a one-paragraph addendum for legal to sign-off; Laura, please attach the standard short-term provisioning addendum.

I’ve attached a provisioning stub you can use to invoice if needed. Keep it on record in HubSpot under deal NL-2027-041.
